boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named public-facing destinations along downtown and Merced corridors beyond UC Merced’s main campus.

cards.title: Merced Theatre
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 301 W Main St
cards.notes: Check the current program, then plan around the listed box-office window or the hour before a scheduled event.
cards.short_summary: A restored downtown venue for films and live performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Merced Theatre lists its address as 301 W Main St and presents films, concerts, comedy, and theatrical performances.
cards.source_title: The Art Kamangar Center at The Merced Theatre
cards.access_notes: Box office: Tuesday–Friday, 1–5 p.m., plus one hour before events unless otherwise noted.

cards.title: Playhouse Merced
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 452 W Main St
cards.notes: Use the season page to choose a Main Stage or youth-production date, and confirm the show’s ticket details before going.
cards.short_summary: A community theater with Main Stage and youth productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Playhouse Merced identifies itself as a community theater and lists its address at 452 W Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Box office hours are Wednesday–Friday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m., plus one hour before showtime.

cards.title: Merced Multicultural Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 645 W Main St
cards.notes: Visit during gallery hours to view the current exhibition; check the center’s events listing for performances or classes.
cards.short_summary: A gallery and performance venue managed by the Merced County Arts Council.
cards.evidence_claim: The Merced Multicultural Arts Center is a gallery and performance venue at 645 W Main Street; its galleries are free to view.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours: Wednesday–Friday 2–8 p.m.; Saturday 11 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Bob Hart Square
cards.subtitle: Main Street and Canal Street corridor — 514 W Main St
cards.notes: Use this named civic square as a stop while walking Main Street, and look for scheduled community gatherings or public art.
cards.short_summary: A downtown civic square at Main and Canal streets.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Merced lists Bob Hart Square at 514 W Main St and describes it as a downtown gathering space for events and celebrations.
cards.source_title: Bob Hart Square | City of Merced
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public square; check event organizers for any event-specific access details.

cards.title: Merced (Main) Library
cards.subtitle: O Street corridor — 2100 O St
cards.notes: Bring a study task or browse the collection; public computer use is available in person, subject to daily availability.
cards.short_summary: The county’s main library offers public resources and scheduled programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County identifies the Merced Main Library at 2100 O St and provides free public internet access at the library.
cards.access_notes: Main library hours: Monday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Tuesday–Wednesday 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Thursday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Merced County Courthouse Museum
cards.subtitle: N Street corridor — 21st Street and N Street
cards.notes: Set aside an afternoon-window visit to see the historic courthouse museum, and confirm the published schedule before traveling downtown.
cards.short_summary: A county museum housed at the historic courthouse location.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County lists the Merced County Courthouse Museum at 21st Street and N Street, open Wednesday through Sunday from 1–4 p.m.

cards.title: UC Merced Downtown Campus Center
cards.subtitle: N Street corridor — 655 W 18th St
cards.notes: Check UC Merced’s current program listings before making a dedicated trip; the center is a named downtown university facility.
cards.short_summary: UC Merced’s downtown facility at 18th and N streets.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced identifies its Downtown Campus Center at 18th and N streets and lists it as a location for in-person classes.
cards.source_title: Facilities and Information Technology | UC Merced PACE
cards.access_notes: Building access and class availability may vary; consult the relevant UC Merced program before visiting.

cards.title: Applegate Park
cards.subtitle: W 25th Street corridor — between R and M streets
cards.notes: Use the bike path, picnic area, courts, or playground for an outdoor stop; bring what you need and observe posted park rules.
cards.short_summary: A 32-acre regional park with recreation amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Merced lists Applegate Park at 1045 W 25th Street, between R and M streets, with a bike path, picnic shelter, courts, and playground.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park amenities are listed by the City of Merced; check posted conditions and rules on arrival.

cards.title: Merced Applegate Zoo
cards.subtitle: W 25th Street corridor — 1045 W 25th St
cards.notes: Plan a daytime wildlife visit and review the zoo’s animal-care rules before arrival, including its restrictions on outside pets and wheeled devices.
cards.short_summary: A city zoo caring for rescued mammals, birds, and reptiles.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced Applegate Zoo at 1045 W 25th Street houses roughly 75 mammals, birds, and reptiles, including California native species from wildlife rescue centers.
cards.source_title: Merced Applegate Zoo | City of Merced
cards.access_notes: Hours: Thursday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Monday–Wednesday and specified holidays.

cards.title: Yosemite Wildlife Museum
cards.subtitle: Yosemite Parkway corridor — 2040 Yosemite Pkwy
cards.notes: Pair this museum stop with a daytime trip along Yosemite Parkway, and confirm the county’s listed operating schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A county-listed wildlife museum on Yosemite Parkway.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County lists the Yosemite Wildlife Museum at 2040 Yosemite Parkway, with hours Tuesday through Saturday from 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published museum hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
